# profile (wildcard style)

Profile pictures. `profile-800x800` is the upload for YouTube (it shows in a circle), with a 1600 x 1600 master and a preview in the circle at real sizes. `general` is a 1000 x 1000 square and a circle-cropped version for other sites. No photo versions were made: no photo (me.jpg) was supplied.
